items.title: Old WinRAR Flaw Fuels Attacks on Ukraine: How Unmanaged Software Keeps the Door Open
items.content: Two Russia-aligned campaigns continue exploiting CVE-2025-8088, a WinRAR path traversal vulnerability patched in July 2025, against Ukrainian organizations through April 2026. SHADOW-EARTH-066 deploys an evolved GIFTEDCROOK information stealer using in-memory DLL loading via direct NT system calls, harvesting browser credentials, session cookies, and documents across 35 file extensions before...
